description: Panorama along the summit ridge — the fullest working view of the site. Foreground: giant weathered boulders ringed with sandbag walls, a smoking field stove or burn barrel at left, stacked tires, lumber, crates, wire, and a small wooden table. Center: a tall FLAGPOLE flying a YELLOW FLAG WITH RED STRIPES — the flag of the Republic of Vietnam — beside the rock-built observation structure with its ladder (painted white lettering on its face, partially visible, not resolvable). Light smoke drifts across the position; a few figures move among the fortifications. Beyond the ridge the plain spreads out far below under scattered cloud; scrub and felled brush on the right slope with more sandbag bunkers and tent flys.
